question: Which background-work features belong in every bot by default?

options.label: Task lists and queues only
options.tradeoff: Organize multiple requested jobs without recurring unattended work.

options.label: Queues and reminders
options.tradeoff: Also schedule notifications without scheduled agent runs.

options.label: Queues, reminders and scheduled agents
options.tradeoff: Most capable; needs explicit schedules and controls for unattended work.

options.label: Session threads only
options.tradeoff: Smallest default; add automation only where needed.

planning_focus: Deferred: establish argument-free /new and category/thread command behavior first.
